From: Manuel Eberl <manuel@pruvisto.org>

Hello,

I've been getting a lot of emails like this for the past few weeks. I
can't remember getting these before then. I wonder if some change
happened during that time that affected memory consumption. It seems to
be the either the generation of the SAT instance or the import of the
SAT proof that causes this.

Surprisingly, I don't recall getting a single email about the entry
SWF_Impossibility, which does something very similar but four times
instead of one, and two of the SAT proofs involved are quite a bit
bigger than the one in PAPP_Impossibility.

Manuel
